question.knowledge_point: Plotting the Product of a Matrix and an Eigenvector Given its Corresponding Eigenvalue
question.problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14071103/assets/312c7d003e2d856e55b3b5700402aa86b53e43dcd8f8650b4e04476b8be9b585.png)

The vector $v$ is an eigenvector of a $2\times 2$ matrix $C$ corresponding to the eigenvalue $-2.$ Find the vector $Cv.$
question.worked_solution:
The eigenvector $v=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ -2\end{aligned}]$ corresponds to the eigenvalue $\lambda =-2.$ So, 

$$
\begin{aligned}Cv & =-2v.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have the following picture:
